# The files of other programs in this directory

Each file here was written by another program, and published in a repository
under the license named below. Each is kept byte for byte, as fetched from
`https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OWNER/REPO/COMMIT/PATH` on 2026-10-30, so
that `podssh config import` is tested on real exports (T-292). The license of
each repository follows, as it was at that commit.

| File | Repository | Commit | Path there | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `putty-session.reg` | ctxis/DynamicLabs | `e03ba4b9bccc129819520a76be5552da7b9b3a17` | `Ansible/tasks/attacks/T1552_2/puttyregkey/putty_session.reg` | MIT |
| `putty-default-jumplist.reg` | chauncey-garrett/dotfiles | `74b4c13665e18ec3b058ffc420932fdb39031880` | `putty/putty.reg` | MIT |
| `putty-utf8-bom.reg` | sstallion/dotfiles | `ead220ca6e198c066f626e740d95ccf7609b2cbb` | `extra/Windows/PuTTY.reg` | BSD-2-Clause |
| `putty-unix/Default%20Settings` | KunoiSayami/dotfiles | `f8d4b6fdc1c6ca075231d2ea4b9cbd846b73b07c` | `.putty/sessions/Default%20Settings` | Unlicense |
| `mobaxterm-ice.mxtsessions` | OElabed/ice-microservices | `2273860d63e496b49e9642aef314b68e08d21a79` | `dev-tools/ice-sessions.mxtsessions` | MIT |
| `remmina-ssh-template.remmina` | OneIdentity/SCALUS | `24e7efa58e5f413b2b4ea80a023525963d8f0aaf` | `scripts/examples/ssh.remmina` | MIT |
